_source: Genshin Impact Wiki, read 22 Nov 2026: Havoc: Warp (Elemental Skill: Seven-Phase Flash hits), Havoc: Ruin (Burst; Havoc: Extinction), Return to Oblivion (A4), Reason Beyond Reason (A1), Finale of the Deep Galleries, The Black Sword. Talent values are % of ATK, by talent level.

extinction._text: After Havoc: Extinction, every 0.1s the next Normal Attack hit deals increased DMG, more with Void Rifts absorbed; cancelled after 10 triggers. Values are the 0/1/2/3-rift bonus (%), modelled as DMG bonus on those 10 hits (the wiki labels them 'DMG Bonus (%)').

deathsCrossing._text: A4: one stack per Hydro teammate and per Cryo teammate other than Skirk, max 3; Seven-Phase Flash Normal Attacks deal this share of their DMG

finale4pc._text: 0 Energy: Normal Attack DMG +60% (Skirk's Burst uses no Energy)

blackSword._text: Normal and Charged Attack DMG +20% at R1
